name: Indo-German Science and Technology Centre (IGSTC): Women Involvement in Science and Engineering Research (WISER)
summary: Women Involvement in Science and Engineering Research (WISER), a programme by the Indo-German Science and Technology Centre (IGSTC), aims to build scientific capacity, encourage, and promote women researchers. Applications for the WISER
